title: Jewel Toned Crispy Algerian Vegetable Tagine
description: A charred and crispy lacto-vegetarian friendly Algerian dish featuring mixed peel and tadka, served in a tagliere vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the carrots, zucchini, and red bell pepper with olive oil, tadka spice blend, and garlic until they are evenly coated.
Spread the vegetables in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast for 20 minutes.
Remove the baking sheet from the oven and stir in the mixed peel.
Return the baking sheet to the oven and continue roasting for an additional 10 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender and lightly charred.
Remove the baking sheet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Stir in the yogurt and season with salt to taste.
Transfer the vegetable mixture to a tagliere vessel and serve hot.
